observations: Black and white office printer with a beige top section.
The brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub c3351' are printed on the front left of the machine.
The unit is wrapped in clear plastic film and appears to be in a warehouse or storage area.
A large promotional sticker is attached to the front, but the text is too blurry to read.
The machine has a paper output tray visible at the bottom right.
The top lid is closed in all photos.

claims.evidence: The colour function is not visible in the photos; the sticker is too blurry to read.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or print.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and printing a test page.

risks.risk: The colour printing function may be faulty or the toner cartridge may be empty.
risks.proof: A photo of a colour test page or a printed colour document.

risks.risk: The internal drum and toner may be past their service life or have been used.
risks.proof: A photo of the internal drum and a toner refill cartridge.
risks.if_unproven: as used with a used drum

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the internal drum and toner cartridge.
Photo of a colour test page or a printed colour document.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
